profile.headline: Robotics | ADAS | Automotive Engineering
profile.summary:
A highly motivated individual pursuing a career in Autonomous Driving Technology. Enthusiastic about technological  advances in the field of Robotics, Mechatronics and Automation Systems Engineering.

I can be reached at dikshantpatel95@gmail.com

You can also access my personal projects at my website: https://sites.google.com/site/dikshantpatel1995/

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software Development · Automotive Engineering · Software Design · Software Systems Engineering

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer | Active Saftey Advanced Engineering
Autonomous Driving Embedded Engineer
positions.description: Working as a embedded software engineer in the sensing team. Working on sensor fusion algorithms and developing sensor interfaces to the middleware.

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Co-op Intern
positions.description:
Implemented a constant time-off based circuit which improved dimming response (up-to <0.5%)
 Developed a linear LED driver configuration with Color control using MCU (<6% current ripple)
 Developing Snubbers, EMC Filter to reduce EMI signature of the LED Drivers (EMI margin >=9dB)
 Sensor, RF based technology Integration(NFC antenna Design/Matching, RF/2.4Ghz based communication, PIR/Ambient light Sensor)
 Developing & verifying Schematics/PCB layouts, Reliability tests (HI-Pot, Surge testing, Derating Test).

positions.title: Embedded Engineer (Volunteer)
positions.description:
Developed the drive train control and PID Steering control for the EcoPRT Autonomous Vehicle.
 Improved motor control circuit board with speed regulation to a 14-KW brushless DC motor.
 Developed reliable PID based braking system with the brake actuator control circuit.
 Sensor integration for emergency braking (Sonar, Lidar).
 Integrated wireless emergency braking for the vehicle using 2.4GHz Radio module.
 Tested and prototyped custom circuit based sensors and power distribution circuits.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked as an engineering intern at the company and studied about the Instrumentation & Automation in paper mills. I also pursued a comprehensive study of Power Generation Plant of the company and the integration of various industrial sensors to the central Distributive Control System .

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked as a summer intern at the company and worked individually and designed a clinker cooler management system to control the temperature of the system and a hydraulic kiln analysis probe cleaner system to clean the tube of the probe when a blockage was detected. I learned to work with actuators like relays, solenoid valves and different sensing elements used in the industry.

educations.schoolName: Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani

projects.title: Construction Survey Robot using Husky Rover
projects.description: Involved with the hardware team which developed low level interface APIs on ROS, implemented safety kill switch mechanism using multi-threaded python script on Embedded ARM system, designed power distribution SMPS (DC-DC) circuits and integrating Lidar and Pan and tilt unit.

projects.title: ECG sensing using Capacitive (Non-Contact) Electrodes
projects.description: Working towards the completion of the course project for the Biomedical Instrumentation course. We are trying to develop a novel system using non contact capacitive coupled electrode to sense ECG signals making no skin contact. This system is being developed for the use of first respondents.

publications.title: Robotics in Dental Implantation
publications.publisher: International Conference on Advancements in Materials for Manufacturing (ICAAMM-2016) · Jul 7, 2016

publications.title: An Understanding of Construction of Robotic Arm for Massaging Applications.
publications.publisher: National Conference on Recent Advances in Manufacturing and Robotics (RAMR-2016) · Apr 23, 2016
